title: THE LITTLE GOD OF UNKEPT PROMISES
deck: By sunset, Mount Vey will collapse onto a city where a minor god has made every promise physically binding. Illuminara must free a father from his doorway, two children from forever, and exhausted workers from a mayor’s vow—without teaching the powerful that accountability is only for other people.
shape: Five scenes move from visible private bonds and a hard quarry clock, through Sef’s history of elite impunity and his discovery of a loophole in Illuminara’s first design, into a worker-built rescue whose ninety-three-second tram sequence and consent conditions are visible before they are tested. A flooded cellar and lost road make the eleven-second risk real. Offered a terminable witness key before the crisis, Sef freely releases literal control; the trapped escape and a renewable court gives both promises and freedom an answer.

scenes.title: The Doorway
paragraphs: *Veyra, the east ward · 08:12, ten hours before sunset*

Oren Vale leaned into his own open doorway until the tendons stood in his neck. His left boot crossed the sill. His right would not lift. Nothing visible held it, yet the floorboards groaned as if a cart horse pulled the other way.

**Lio**  
Dad, stop. Your ankle is bleeding.
His daughter knelt on the street side with a quarry alarm bell in one hand. Beyond her, a pale line of dust hung above Mount Vey. Each time the bell sounded, the mountain answered a heartbeat later.

**Oren**  
I promised your mother I would never leave you alone in this house.

**Lio**  
I am standing outside it. I am asking you to leave with me.

**Oren**  
The promise does not know the difference.

Across the lane, Mina and Cal moved with their wrists held a handspan apart by a thread of amber light. At nine they had sworn to be friends forever. At twelve, Mina had earned a place on a river school; Cal had refused to let her board the coach because every step away burned both their arms.

**Mina**  
We meant it when we said it.

**Cal**  
That is the worst part.

Illuminara came down without thunder. She put one palm against Oren’s lintel. The pressure was not in the wood. It ran under the street, through thousands of doorstones, marriage rings, guild marks and burial tablets, all converging on the black quarry above the city.

A small figure sat on the lintel where her hand had been. He was no taller than Lio’s forearm. His coat was stitched from torn contracts; his eyes were two drops of sealing wax. When he spoke, every promise in the street tightened.

**Sef**  
If words may be escaped whenever they hurt, the weak are the only ones who must believe them.

**Illuminara**  
I did not come to teach you that words are cheap.

**Sef**  
You came because the mayor’s quarry is breaking my oldest covenant. Powerful people always discover mercy when consequence reaches their own door.
The second alarm sounded. Dust rolled from Mount Vey in a thicker ribbon. Lio unfolded a quarry map. A red crack had reached the ventilation stair where three hundred night workers were still below.

**Lio**  
Forewoman Sen says the east shelf will fall at 17:42. The mayor promised work to every household. Sef made the promise true. Half the city is too exhausted to shore the shelf, and no one assigned to the quarry can leave.

**Illuminara**  
My aim is to get every person out before the shelf falls, without breaking the covenant that keeps the mountain off the city.

**Sef**  
Then begin with the part you dislike. Ask who paid when promises were only admired.
He stepped into a crack in the lintel and vanished. Oren’s right foot remained fixed.
Illuminara lifted Lio’s alarm bell and felt its chipped bronze warm in her hand. *He had not refused help. He had refused another exception made by someone strong enough to call it mercy.*

**Illuminara**  
Show me the Hall of Oaths. Then we go to the quarry together.

Lio glanced at her father. Oren stopped pulling at the threshold, wrapped his ankle, and nodded. It was not rescue yet. It was the first time that morning someone had asked him to act rather than endure.

scenes.title: What Sef Heard
paragraphs: *Hall of Oaths · 10:05, seven hours and thirty-seven minutes before collapse*

The hall had no statues. Its walls were built from promise stones: one for every vow on which another person’s safety had depended. Bright stones marked fulfilled obligations. Dark ones marked breaches. Most of the dark stones bore the crests of old councils, mining houses and temples.

Sef stood on the clerk’s table. Around him gathered Oren, Lio, Mina, Cal, Forewoman Ilya Sen, Mayor Teren Vos and forty citizens chosen by the quarry crews. No guard stood at the doors. Sef had made every official who promised public service unable to leave.

**Mayor Vos**  
Release the workers and I will sign any amendment you draft.

**Sef**  
You signed six safety amendments. When production fell, you called each one aspirational.

**Mayor Vos**  
The city would have starved.

**Ilya**  
You promised every family wages, then counted compulsory double shifts as employment. We did not starve. We broke.

Illuminara touched a dark stone bearing the mayoral crest. It held not words but consequences: Ilya’s crushed fingers; a widow’s unanswered petition; children carrying meals to parents who slept beside the lifts.

**Illuminara**  
Sef, when did you begin binding every promise literally?

**Sef**  
After the seventh council swore to repair the west retaining wall and used the money for a triumph gate. The slide killed four hundred and twelve. Their last breath was full of official language.

**Illuminara**  
So your goal is not obedience. It is recourse.
The wax in Sef’s eyes trembled, but his voice stayed hard.

**Sef**  
Recourse that cannot be postponed by the eloquent. A promise that changes when the promiser suffers is merely a weapon with a velvet handle.

**Lio**  
And a promise that cannot hear the person it was made to becomes a cage. My mother asked Dad to keep me safe, not to die inside our doorway.

**Oren**  
I used her last words because deciding what came next frightened me. Sef did not invent that.
Cal raised his glowing wrist. Mina raised hers beside it.

**Cal**  
I wanted forever because everyone in my house leaves.

**Mina**  
I stayed because his fear hurt me less than hurting him. That does not make staying freely chosen.
For one moment the amber thread slackened, then tightened again. Sef had listened; he had not conceded.

**Sef**  
If I accept intention over words, Mayor Vos will discover that he intended justice all along.

**Illuminara**  
Then do not let the promiser decide. Let the person who relied on the promise name the harm. Let release require truth, repair and a new choice—not cleverer wording.

**Mayor Vos**  
A tribunal during a mountain emergency?

**Ilya**  
A tribunal is what you call it when workers get a chair.
The hall shuddered. A line of dust fell from the ceiling. On the quarry map, the red crack crossed another support gallery. The clock now read seven hours, twenty-nine minutes.

**Sef**  
Words again. Test them where stone can answer.

He struck the table. Three promise stones rose: the mayor’s employment vow, Oren’s doorway vow, and the children’s forever vow. Beneath them lay a fourth, older and brighter than all the rest: the city’s covenant to keep the drainage channels clear so Mount Vey would sleep.

**Sef**  
Break every bond and the old covenant breaks with them. Keep every bond and the exhausted crews die. Show me accountability that survives freedom.

Illuminara did not reach for power. She asked Ilya for the quarry ledgers, Lio for the petitions no clerk had answered, and Sef for the names of those who had relied on each promise. Sef gave her the names.

scenes.title: The Price Named by the Harmed
paragraphs: *East quarry assembly floor · 13:48, three hours and fifty-four minutes before collapse*

The quarry floor had been cleared beneath a roof of cracked slate. Every eight minutes, a brass plumb bob swung farther east. Ilya had painted three evacuation lines on the ground. The workers stood behind the lines by crew, not by rank.

Illuminara could have carried them out. The covenant ran through the drainage tunnels, however, and a forced severing would send the saturated upper slope into Veyra. Her strength could hold one shelf for ninety-three seconds. The mountain held six.

**Illuminara**  
Here is my first proposal. Every safety promise names its beneficiaries, duration, proof and a way to demand repair. Changed circumstances may reopen its terms. Those harmed decide whether repair is enough.

**Sef**  
Who declares the circumstances changed?

**Illuminara**  
Either party could ask—

**Sef**  
Then Mayor Vos will call falling profits a changed circumstance. He will reopen the promise, keep the benefit and describe the breach as negotiation. You have built him a polite door.
Illuminara looked down at the clause she had thought was fair. *Sef knew not only how promises trapped people, but how power escaped them.* She struck the sentence through.

**Illuminara**  
Only a person who relied on the promise may trigger a reopening. Immediate danger may justify a provisional departure, but it starts a public repair hearing within one day. The promiser cannot rewrite the harm.

**Ilya**  
And the hearing begins with the injured, not the office that broke the promise.

**Sef**  
Better. Not safe. Better.

Ilya rolled the quarry cutaway across the slate. The loaded waste tram stood above the north stair on a relief rail whose haul cable crossed the east fracture. If its brake were released, it would clear the stair, travel for ninety-three seconds and pull the fractured shelf toward the abandoned cut.

Illuminara traced the crack with two fingers and marked the point where the cable would take the load. Ilya checked the tram mass against the six crews’ recorded weights, then made the north-stair release and the counterweight one timed sequence. The workers—not a hidden machine—would set the brake, clear the route and call the final latch.

**Illuminara**  
I can hold the shelf for the tram’s ninety-three-second descent. Not for a hundred. If the route changes, you call the change.

**Ilya**  
Then your strength follows our clock.

Ilya laid three demands on the stone table. The quarry would close until an elected crew inspected every gallery. Vos would surrender his quarry shares to a restitution trust. For five years, half the council seats overseeing public works would belong to workers and bereaved families.
Vos removed the mayoral seal and signed away his office, his half of the house and every quarry share. He sent a runner for Maro and the children before anyone could mistake his signature for theirs.

While they waited, Mina and Cal wrote their own repair: each would tell the other one thing the vow had cost; neither would ask for contact for thirty days; after that, friendship could be renewed only by two yeses.

**Cal**  
If she says no after thirty days, what holds me?

**Sef**  
Nothing.

**Cal**  
That feels like falling.

**Mina**  
I will sit with you until the coach comes. I will not promise what happens after.
Cal wept without hiding his face. Sef climbed down from the table and sat beside him. He did not loosen the amber thread.

**Sef**  
I was made from that fear. Every promise is a bridge over the fact that another being may leave.

Lio placed an unused witness seal on the floor beside him. It was plain iron, cut for two keys. Her written offer gave Sef the witness key for one hearing only, or permission to leave it untouched. The quarry gate was not its price, and no one could bind him to the chair.

**Sef**  
A place offered can become another promise.

**Illuminara**  
So it expires after one hearing. You choose again. If you never take it, the chair remains empty and the court still owes you nothing.
Sef did not touch the seal. He also did not step away from it.

The runner returned with Vos’s family. Maro read the demands twice, closed his hand around the house key and refused to spend the children’s home on Teren’s debt. He conceded one concrete term: they would keep three rooms through winter while the clinic used the ground floor. The remaining purchase, trust and repair terms would be heard after the evacuation.

Vos reached for the key, stopped, and signed only the property and shares that were his to give. Ilya turned the page toward the waiting witnesses. His title was gone; his family’s boundary remained outside his control.

Illuminara signed beneath the tram calculation: ninety-three seconds when Ilya called, the evacuation route above her improvisation, and the same public review for any force she used in Veyra that day. She offered no forever.

**Sef**  
You could leave before judgment.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. The record gives people an answer if I do: publish my breach, refuse my aid and summon witnesses beyond this city. Trust is not certainty. It is power arranged so betrayal has an answer.

Sef looked toward the lower terraces, where Lio’s runners were already carrying the names he had supplied in the Hall. The people protected by the drainage covenant would be asked what risk, if any, they would accept.
The plumb bob struck its warning mark twenty-three minutes early.

**Ilya**  
The crack accelerated. New collapse time: 17:19.

No one asked Sef to believe a definition. They carried a corrected proposal, a checked ninety-three-second plan, an unclaimed witness seal and three possible evacuation answers to the failing galleries.

scenes.title: Ninety-Three Seconds
paragraphs: *Mount Vey, east shelf · 17:16, three minutes before collapse*

Rainwater hissed through the upper fracture. Below it, six crews moved along routes they had chosen. Ilya held the two-stage release lever: its first pull would send the loaded ore tram down the ninety-three-second relief rail and clear the north stair; its final latch would drop the tram into the empty cut and tension the haul cable across the fracture. Lio stood at the signal bell. Oren waited at the city doorway, still bound, ready to cross if Sef released him.

At the lower spillway stood Ressa Daan, whose bakery and cellar occupied the first terrace, and Toma Ely, chosen by the east-lane households. They held the reply bells. No one claimed they spoke for the whole city; they carried the recorded answers of the people on the routes that would take the eleven-second surge.

**Ilya**  
Test condition one: the workers may refuse the mayor’s employment promise without losing their claim to wages.

**Sef**  
If I release them, who keeps the drainage covenant?
Thirty-two workers raised their hands. Not one was compelled.

**Workers**  
We renew the drainage covenant for this evacuation and for thirty days. After that, renewal requires inspection, pay and a recorded vote.

**Ilya**  
Test condition two: those harmed retain the power to reject repair.

**Mina**  
I accept thirty days apart.

**Cal**  
I accept that she may not return.

Sef opened one small hand. The amber thread between the children dissolved into warm sparks. Cal staggered, then stood without grabbing Mina. Mina took his hand for three breaths and let go. Both choices held.

In the city, Oren’s right foot lifted. He crossed the doorway and ran toward the lower drainage gate with Lio’s spare key. His promise did not vanish; it changed into a record of care, harm and consent that Lio had accepted.

**Sef**  
And the mayor?

**Mayor Vos**  
Do not release my debt. Release the workers from my command.
The promise stones around the quarry flared. The ore tram gates opened. Workers who had been physically unable to abandon assigned stations moved toward the stairs.
At 17:18:07 the east shelf split.

**Ilya**  
Now, Illuminara.

Ilya pulled the first detent. The loaded tram began its ninety-three-second descent, clearing the north stair as its wheels took the cable strain. The crews had built the sequence; Illuminara had shown them where the fracture would accept it.

Illuminara went beneath the falling shelf and raised both hands. Two million tonnes of slate stopped a spear’s length above her. The impact drove her knees into stone. Lio’s clock began with the tram’s descent: ninety-three seconds to the empty cut.

Sef saw the sixth crew still trapped behind a contract-marked gate. Releasing them would weaken the old covenant for eleven seconds before the volunteers’ renewal reached the promise stones. In those seconds the lower spillway would flood and the east retaining road might go.

**Sef**  
If I keep them, the mountain sleeps and they die. If I free them, other people pay.

**Illuminara**  
Then ask the people who would pay.
Lio rang the question sequence: eleven seconds, lower spillway, east road. Ressa’s bell answered once: yes with a condition. Toma’s answered twice: no.

**Ressa**  
Keep the spillway open even if my cellar floods. My ovens are not worth a crew.

**Toma**  
The east lane is not clear. Six households are still moving the bedbound. No gate until Lio gives three bells.

The clock passed forty-one. Ilya changed the plan. The north-stair crew abandoned two carts of shoring timber and ran to carry the last east-lane residents above the red line. The lost timber meant the processing hall could not be saved.

**Sef**  
You accept the cellar and the road?

**Ressa**  
I accept my cellar. Toma speaks for the road only when his people are clear.
The clock passed fifty-eight. A support cracked against Illuminara’s shoulder. She did not command Sef or promise that no one would be hurt.
At sixty-four seconds, Lio heard three reply bells from the east lane and struck three of her own. Toma answered once. The condition had been met; his no had become a yes without being overruled.
Sef looked at Ilya, not at the mayor.

**Sef**  
If I open the gate, will your crew renew the drainage covenant before they reach the north stair?

**Ilya**  
Ask them.

Through the bars, the sixth crew answered one by one. Twenty-one said yes. Three said no; they had been on duty thirty-six hours and would accept no new promise until they slept. Ilya assigned their section to rested volunteers, who consented on the record.

At seventy-two seconds, Sef glanced at the plain iron witness seal Lio had left beside the lever. He could have opened the gate without it, and the offer had not been made as payment. He picked up only the witness key.

**Sef**  
One hearing. Then I choose again.
At seventy-five seconds, Sef opened the gate.

For eleven seconds, Mount Vey moved. Oren reached the lower gate and locked the emergency spillway open. Brown water filled Ressa’s cellar and tore the east retaining road into the abandoned orchard. The six households were already above it. Lio struck the new sequence; rested volunteers renewed only the drainage work they had named. The bright covenant stone held.

At eighty-eight seconds, the loaded tram reached the empty cut. Ilya pulled the final latch. The tram dropped, the haul cable snapped taut, and the fractured shelf turned away from the city along the line Illuminara had marked.

**Ilya**  
Clear!

Illuminara released the stone at ninety-two seconds. The shelf fell into the abandoned quarry. The old processing hall, three cranes and the mayoral triumph arch disappeared under dust. No house in Veyra moved.

For a moment Mina laughed—not because the loss was small, but because Cal had let her run and had run beside someone else. Illuminara laughed too, breathless and astonished. The sound was her own, not a lesson for anyone.
Sef stood on her dust-covered shoulder with the witness key closed in his wax hand. He was still small. He no longer looked like a jailer, but neither did he look harmless.

**Sef**  
Three workers refused. Toma refused until his people were clear. The covenant lived.

**Ilya**  
Good. Come witness the cost before the next renewal.

scenes.title: The Court of Open Hands
paragraphs: *Veyra, the former mayoral house · dawn, the following day*

The front rooms had become a temporary clinic before the dust settled. Maro and his children kept three rooms upstairs through winter; in spring, the trust could offer an assessed purchase only if they accepted it. Vos’s half of the house and every quarry share he owned were sealed in the restitution trust. He slept on a bench outside the records office, waiting to testify.
At the long table sat workers, bereaved families, apprentices, clerks and two seats kept empty for people who had not yet decided whether to join. Above them hung no image of Sef.
Sef sat in one of the empty seats and set the witness key beside his hand. The chair continued an offer he had accepted for one hearing, not a reward for opening the gate.

**Ilya**  
This court preserves the record, hears the people who relied on a promise, and certifies repair or release. It cannot compel a new promise.

**Sef**  
And my power?

**Ilya**  
You may make concealed consequences visible. You may not bind a body until the person harmed has been heard and immediate safety requires it. Every binding expires unless this court renews it with the affected people’s consent.

**Sef**  
You offer a god a clerkship.

**Lio**  
We offer you witnesses who cannot be dismissed as a superstition when officials break their word.
Sef studied the dark stones carried from the old hall. They were no longer hidden in walls. Each lay beside a petition and the name of someone empowered to answer it.

**Sef**  
I will serve for thirty days. Then I choose again.

**Ilya**  
So do we.
Oren entered through the front door carrying a kettle. He paused on the sill by habit, then crossed. Lio did not applaud. She took the heavier handle, and together they brought tea to the night crew.

**Oren**  
I cannot repair twelve years by crossing once.

**Lio**  
No. But today you crossed when I needed you outside.

Mina’s river coach left at noon. Cal came to the platform with Sef and did not ask for a promise. Mina gave Cal a paper address that might change. Cal gave her a carved whistle and told her she did not have to use it.

At Mount Vey, rested volunteers cleared the drainage channels under Ilya’s plan. The quarry stayed closed and wages came from the seized shares. Ressa’s cellar remained flooded; the east road would stay broken through winter. Three families rejected the first restitution offers, and the court recorded their refusals without punishment.

Vos disclosed the diverted funds and named the councilors who had approved them. When he tried to explain that every choice had protected employment, Ilya made him read the night-shift injury list before he continued.

Illuminara submitted her ninety-two seconds of force to review. A rigger objected that the falling shelf had shattered a memorial crane. She listened, recovered its nameplate with him, and accepted the requirement that the crane be rebuilt before any monument to the rescue.
Sef watched with the severe attention of a creature learning that consequence could have more than one shape.

Before she left, Illuminara set Lio’s chipped bell within his reach and opened her palm beneath the edge of his chair. Sef looked at the offered hand, then climbed down by the chair rung instead. She withdrew without turning his refusal into a lesson and left the bell where he could choose it.

**Sef**  
The weak still need words they can trust.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.

**Sef**  
Freedom will still be used as an excuse by the strong.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. That is why freedom without recourse is unfinished.

**Sef**  
And recourse without freedom becomes me.

He did not apologize for the bindings. Some people were not ready to forgive him, and the court did not ask them to. He placed his sealing-wax hand on the first thirty-day covenant beside Ilya’s inked thumbprint.
Illuminara left Veyra by the east road after breakfast. Behind her, Sef rang Lio’s chipped bell for the next hearing. Two empty chairs remained at the table. No one filled them by force.

critic_line: Illuminara, called to a city where a minor god has made every promise physically binding, refuses to tear the covenant out by force and instead, with the quarry foreman, builds a recourse the harmed control, so that a worker-built ninety-three-second tram sequence brings every trapped crew out, Sef freely opens the gate and a terminable court of open hands gives promises and freedom an answer.

literary_score.method: READER_APPEAL_R1; genuine independent GPT and Claude judgments; exact equal 50/50 arithmetic mean.
shared_strengths: A strong premise (a god who makes promises binding) and thoughtful dialogue about accountability and freedom. The Oren/Lio and Mina/Cal threads are humane. The middle gets heavy with procedural clauses and engineering detail, and the prose is dense and sometimes abstract. Resolution is earned but somewhat tidy.

A vivid moral premise, urgent clock, and compassionate dialogue give the story emotional and intellectual pull. Its consent-based solution and Sef’s uneasy change are memorable, though dense procedural mechanics and repeated governance language may slow some pleasure readers before the rescue.
shared_reservations: Sef did not touch the seal. He also did not step away from it.
Every promise is a bridge over the fact that another being may leave.

translation_sl.title: MALI BOG NEIZPOLNJENIH OBLJUB
translation_sl.deck: Do sončnega zahoda se bo gora Vey zrušila na mesto, kjer je mali bog vsako obljubo naredil fizično zavezujočo. Illuminara mora očeta osvoboditi njegovega praga, otroka njunega za vedno in izčrpane delavce županove zaobljube, ne da bi mogočnim sporočila, da odgovornost velja samo za druge.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov se premakne od vidnih zasebnih vezi in trdega kamnolomskega roka, prek Sefove zgodovine nekaznovanosti elit in njegovega odkritja vrzeli v Illuminarinem prvem načrtu, do reševanja, ki ga zgradijo delavci in katerega triindevetdesetsekundno zaporedje vagona ter pogoji soglasja so vidni pred preizkusom. Poplavljena klet in uničena cesta dajeta enajstsekundnemu tveganju resnično ceno. Sef pred krizo prejme časovno omejen ključ priče in svobodno opusti dobesedni nadzor; ujeti pobegnejo, obnovljivo sodišče pa da odgovor tako obljubam kakor svobodi.

scenes.title: Prag
paragraphs: *Veyra, vzhodna četrt · 08:12, deset ur pred sončnim zahodom*

Oren Vale se je uprl v odprta vrata lastne hiše, dokler mu niso na vratu izstopile kite. Levi škorenj je bil čez prag. Desnega ni mogel dvigniti. Nič vidnega ga ni zadrževalo, a talne deske so ječale, kakor da bi na drugo stran vlekel vprežni konj.

**Lio**  
Oče, nehaj. Gleženj ti krvavi.

Njegova hči je klečala na ulični strani in v eni roki držala kamnolomski opozorilni zvonec. Za njo je nad goro Vey visela bleda črta prahu. Vsakič ko je zazvonilo, je gora odgovorila en srčni utrip pozneje.

**Oren**  
Tvoji materi sem obljubil, da te v tej hiši nikoli ne bom pustil same.

**Lio**  
Stojim zunaj nje. Prosim te, da greš z menoj.

**Oren**  
Obljuba ne pozna razlike.

Na drugi strani ulice sta se Mina in Cal premikala z zapestjema, ki ju je jantarna nit držala za dlan narazen. Pri devetih sta si prisegla, da bosta prijatelja za vedno. Pri dvanajstih je Mina dobila mesto v rečni šoli; Cal ji ni dovolil na voz, ker je vsak korak proč žgal oba v rokah.

**Mina**  
Ko sva to rekla, sva mislila resno.

**Cal**  
To je najhuje.

Illuminara se je spustila brez grmenja. Dlan je položila na Orenovo preklado. Pritisk ni bil v lesu. Tekel je pod ulico, skozi tisoče pragovnih kamnov, poročnih prstanov, cehovskih znamenj in nagrobnih plošč, ki so se vsi stekali v črni kamnolom nad mestom.

Na prekladi, kjer je bila prej njena roka, je sedela drobna postava. Ni bil višji od Liojine podlakti. Plašč je imel sešit iz raztrganih pogodb; oči sta bili dve kaplji pečatnega voska. Ko je spregovoril, se je vsaka obljuba v ulici zategnila.

**Sef**  
Če je mogoče besedam uiti vsakič, ko zabolijo, jim morajo verjeti samo šibki.

**Illuminara**  
Nisem te prišla učit, da so besede poceni.

**Sef**  
Prišla si, ker županov kamnolom lomi mojo najstarejšo zavezo. Mogočni vedno odkrijejo usmiljenje, ko posledica pride pred njihova vrata.

Oglasil se je drugi alarm. Z gore Vey se je skotalil debelejši trak prahu. Lio je razgrnila načrt kamnoloma. Rdeča razpoka je dosegla prezračevalno stopnišče, pod katerim je bilo še vedno tristo nočnih delavcev.

**Lio**  
Delovodkinja Sen pravi, da se bo vzhodna polica zrušila ob 17:42. Župan je vsakemu gospodinjstvu obljubil delo. Sef je obljubo uresničil. Pol mesta je preveč izčrpanega, da bi podprlo polico, nihče, ki je razporejen v kamnolom, pa ne more oditi.

**Illuminara**  
Moj cilj je spraviti vse ven, preden se polica zruši, ne da bi prelomila zavezo, ki goro zadržuje nad mestom.

**Sef**  
Potem začni z delom, ki ti ni všeč. Vprašaj, kdo je plačeval, ko so obljube samo občudovali.
Stopil je v razpoko v prekladi in izginil. Orenovo desno stopalo je ostalo prikovano.
Illuminara je dvignila Liojin opozorilni zvonec in začutila, kako se ji okrušeni bron greje v dlani. *Pomoči ni zavrnil. Zavrnil je še eno izjemo, ki jo nekdo dovolj močan lahko imenuje usmiljenje.*

**Illuminara**  
Pokaži mi Dvorano priseg. Potem greva skupaj v kamnolom.
Lio je pogledala očeta. Oren se je nehal vleči čez prag, si obvezal gleženj in prikimal. To še ni bila rešitev. Prvič tistega jutra ga je nekdo prosil, naj nekaj stori, namesto da samo prenaša.

scenes.title: Kar je slišal Sef
paragraphs: *Dvorana priseg · 10:05, sedem ur in sedemintrideset minut pred zrušitvijo*

V dvorani ni bilo kipov. Stene so bile zgrajene iz kamnov obljub: po enega za vsako zaobljubo, od katere je bila odvisna varnost drugega človeka. Svetli kamni so označevali izpolnjene obveznosti. Temni so označevali kršitve. Večina temnih je nosila grbe starih svetov, rudarskih hiš in templjev.

Sef je stal na pisarjevi mizi. Okoli njega so se zbrali Oren, Lio, Mina, Cal, delovodkinja Ilya Sen, župan Teren Vos in štirideset prebivalcev, ki so jih izbrale kamnolomske izmene. Pri vratih ni bilo nobenega stražarja. Sef je vsakemu uradniku, ki je obljubil javno službo, onemogočil odhod.

**Župan Vos**  
Izpusti delavce in podpisal bom vsak amandma, ki ga sestaviš.

**Sef**  
Podpisal si šest varnostnih amandmajev. Ko je proizvodnja padla, si vsakega razglasil za nezavezujočo željo.

**Župan Vos**  
Mesto bi stradalo.

**Ilya**  
Vsaki družini si obljubil plačo, nato pa obvezne dvojne izmene štel za zaposlitev. Nismo stradali. Zlomili smo se.

Illuminara se je dotaknila temnega kamna z županovim grbom. V njem niso bile besede, temveč posledice: Ilyini zdrobljeni prsti; neodgovorjena vdovina prošnja; otroci, ki so nosili hrano staršem, spečim ob dvigalih.

**Illuminara**  
Sef, kdaj si začel vsako obljubo vezati dobesedno?

**Sef**  
Potem ko je sedmi svet prisegel, da bo popravil zahodni podporni zid, denar pa porabil za slavolok. Plaz je ubil štiristo dvanajst ljudi. Njihov zadnji dih je bil poln uradniškega jezika.

**Illuminara**  
Tvoj cilj torej ni poslušnost. Je možnost povračila.
Vosek v Sefovih očeh je zatrepetal, toda glas mu je ostal trd.

**Sef**  
Povračilo, ki ga zgovorni ne morejo odlagati. Obljuba, ki se spremeni, ko trpi tisti, ki jo je dal, je zgolj orožje z žametnim ročajem.

**Lio**  
Obljuba, ki ne more slišati človeka, kateremu je bila dana, pa postane kletka. Mama je očeta prosila, naj me varuje, ne naj umre znotraj najinega praga.

**Oren**  
Njene zadnje besede sem uporabil, ker me je bilo strah odločiti, kaj sledi. Tega si Sef ni izmislil.
Cal je dvignil žareče zapestje. Mina je ob njem dvignila svojega.

**Cal**  
Za vedno sem hotel zato, ker vsi v moji hiši odidejo.

**Mina**  
Ostala sem, ker me je njegov strah bolel manj kot to, da bi prizadela njega. To še ne pomeni, da sem ostala svobodno.
Jantarna nit je za trenutek popustila, nato pa se spet zategnila. Sef je poslušal; ni popustil.

**Sef**  
Če sprejmem namen namesto besed, bo župan Vos odkril, da je že ves čas nameraval ravnati pravično.

**Illuminara**  
Potem naj ne odloča tisti, ki je obljubo dal. Človek, ki se je nanjo zanesel, naj poimenuje škodo. Oprostitev naj zahteva resnico, popravo in novo izbiro, ne spretnejših besed.

**Župan Vos**  
Razsodišče sredi gorske nevarnosti?

**Ilya**  
Razsodišče temu rečete, ko delavci dobijo stol.
Dvorana se je stresla. S stropa je padla črta prahu. Na načrtu kamnoloma je rdeča razpoka prečkala še en podporni rov. Ura je zdaj kazala sedem ur in devetindvajset minut.

**Sef**  
Spet besede. Preizkusi jih tam, kjer lahko odgovori kamen.

Udaril je po mizi. Dvignili so se trije kamni obljub: županova obljuba zaposlitve, Orenova obljuba na pragu in otroška obljuba za vedno. Pod njimi je ležal četrti, starejši in svetlejši od vseh: mestna zaveza, da bodo odvodni kanali ostali čisti, da bo gora Vey spala.

**Sef**  
Pretrgaj vse vezi in z njimi se pretrga stara zaveza. Ohrani vse vezi in izčrpane izmene umrejo. Pokaži mi odgovornost, ki preživi svobodo.

Illuminara ni posegla po moči. Ilyo je prosila za kamnolomske evidence, Lio za prošnje, na katere ni odgovoril noben pisar, Sefa pa za imena tistih, ki so se zanesli na posamezne obljube. Sef ji je imena dal.

scenes.title: Ceno določijo prizadeti
paragraphs: *Zbirno nadstropje vzhodnega kamnoloma · 13:48, tri ure in štiriinpetdeset minut pred zrušitvijo*

Tla kamnoloma so bila izpraznjena pod streho iz razpokanega skrilavca. Vsakih osem minut je medeninasti grezilec zanihal dlje proti vzhodu. Ilya je na tla narisala tri evakuacijske črte. Delavci so stali za njimi po izmenah, ne po položaju.

Illuminara bi jih lahko odnesla ven. Toda zaveza je tekla skozi odvodne rove in prisilna prekinitev bi namočeno zgornje pobočje poslala nad Veyro. Z močjo bi lahko triindevetdeset sekund držala eno polico. Gora jih je imela šest.

**Illuminara**  
To je moj prvi predlog. Vsaka varnostna obljuba poimenuje upravičence, trajanje, dokaz in način zahteve po popravi. Spremenjene okoliščine lahko ponovno odprejo njene pogoje. Prizadeti odločijo, ali poprava zadošča.

**Sef**  
Kdo razglasi, da so se okoliščine spremenile?

**Illuminara**  
Zaprosi lahko katera koli stran—

**Sef**  
Potem bo župan Vos padec dobička razglasil za spremenjeno okoliščino. Obljubo bo ponovno odprl, korist obdržal, kršitev pa opisal kot pogajanje. Zgradila si mu vljudna vrata.
Illuminara je pogledala določilo, za katero je menila, da je pošteno. *Sef ni vedel le, kako obljube ujamejo ljudi, temveč tudi, kako jim oblast uide.* Stavek je prečrtala.

**Illuminara**  
Ponovno odprtje lahko sproži samo človek, ki se je na obljubo zanesel. Neposredna nevarnost lahko upraviči začasen odmik, vendar ta v enem dnevu sproži javno obravnavo poprave. Tisti, ki je obljubil, ne more prepisati škode.

**Ilya**  
Obravnava pa se začne s poškodovanimi, ne z uradom, ki je obljubo prelomil.

**Sef**  
Bolje. Ni varno. Bolje.

Ilya je čez skrilavec razgrnila prerez kamnoloma. Naložen vagon odpadnega kamna je stal nad severnim stopniščem na razbremenilnem tiru, njegova vlečna jeklenica pa je prečkala vzhodno razpoko. Če bi sprostili zavoro, bi sprostil stopnišče, potoval triindevetdeset sekund in počeno polico potegnil proti opuščenemu useku.

Illuminara je z dvema prstoma sledila razpoki in označila mesto, kjer bi jeklenica prevzela obremenitev. Ilya je maso vagona preverila glede na zabeleženo težo šestih izmen in nato sprostitev severnega stopnišča povezala s protiutežjo v eno časovno zaporedje. Delavci, ne skrit stroj, bi nastavili zavoro, izpraznili pot in poklicali zadnji zapah.

**Illuminara**  
Polico lahko držim med triindevetdesetsekundnim spustom vagona. Ne sto sekund. Če se pot spremeni, spremembo odobriš ti.

**Ilya**  
Potem tvoja moč sledi naši uri.

Ilya je na kamnito mizo položila tri zahteve. Kamnolom bi se zaprl, dokler izvoljena skupina ne pregleda vsakega rova. Vos bi rudarske deleže izročil skladu za povračilo. Pet let bi polovico svetniških sedežev za nadzor javnih del zasedali delavci in žalujoče družine.
Vos je snel županski pečat in podpisal odstop z mesta, svoj delež hiše ter vse rudarske deleže. Poslal je sla po Mara in otroka, še preden bi lahko kdo njegov podpis zamenjal za njihovega.

Med čakanjem sta Mina in Cal zapisala svojo popravo: vsak bi drugemu povedal, kaj ga je zaobljuba stala; trideset dni nobeden ne bi prosil za stik; potem bi se prijateljstvo lahko obnovilo samo z dvema pritrdilnima odgovoroma.

**Cal**  
Če po tridesetih dneh reče ne, kaj me drži?

**Sef**  
Nič.

**Cal**  
Občutek je, kakor da padam.

**Mina**  
Sedela bom s teboj, dokler ne pride voz. Ne bom obljubila, kaj bo potem.
Cal je zajokal, ne da bi skrival obraz. Sef je splezal z mize in sedel k njemu. Jantarne niti ni razrahljal.

**Sef**  
Iz tega strahu sem nastal. Vsaka obljuba je most čez dejstvo, da drugo bitje lahko odide.

Lio je na tla poleg njega položila neuporabljen pečat za pričo. Bil je iz navadnega železa, zarezanim za dva ključa. Njena pisna ponudba je Sefu dajala ključ priče za eno samo obravnavo ali dovoljenje, da ga pusti nedotaknjenega. Vrata kamnoloma niso bila njegova cena in nihče ga ni mogel prikleniti na stol.

**Sef**  
Ponujeno mesto lahko postane še ena obljuba.

**Illuminara**  
Zato poteče po eni obravnavi. Potem se odločiš znova. Če ga nikoli ne vzameš, stol ostane prazen in sodišče ti še vedno ničesar ne dolguje.
Sef se pečata ni dotaknil. Prav tako se ni odmaknil od njega.

Sel se je vrnil z Vosovo družino. Maro je zahteve dvakrat prebral, stisnil hišni ključ in ni dovolil, da bi dolg Terena plačal dom otrok. Sprejel je en konkreten pogoj: skozi zimo bi obdržali tri sobe, pritličje pa bi uporabljala klinika. O preostalem odkupu, skladu in popravi bi odločali po evakuaciji.

Vos je segel po ključu, se ustavil in podpisal samo nepremičnino ter deleže, ki jih je smel dati. Ilya je stran obrnila k čakajočim pričam. Naslov je izgubil; meja njegove družine pa je ostala zunaj njegovega nadzora.

Illuminara se je podpisala pod izračun vagona: triindevetdeset sekund, ko jo pokliče Ilya, evakuacijska pot pred njenim improviziranjem ter enak javni pregled vsake sile, ki bi jo tisti dan uporabila v Veyri. Ničesar ni ponudila za vedno.

**Sef**  
Lahko bi odšla pred razsodbo.

**Illuminara**  
Da. Zapis daje ljudem odgovor, če to storim: objavijo mojo kršitev, zavrnejo mojo pomoč in pokličejo priče od zunaj. Zaupanje ni gotovost. Je moč, urejena tako, da ima izdaja odgovor.

Sef je pogledal proti spodnjim terasam, kjer so Liojini sli že nosili imena, ki jih je dal v Dvorani. Ljudje, ki jih je varovala odvodna zaveza, bi povedali, kakšno tveganje so pripravljeni sprejeti, če sploh kakšno.
Grezilec je opozorilno oznako dosegel triindvajset minut prezgodaj.

**Ilya**  
Razpoka se je pospešila. Nov čas zrušitve: 17:19.

Nihče ni prosil Sefa, naj verjame opredelitvi. V odpovedujoče rove so odnesli popravljen predlog, preverjen triindevetdesetsekundni načrt, neprevzeti pečat za pričo in tri možne odgovore na evakuacijo.

scenes.title: Triindevetdeset sekund
paragraphs: *Gora Vey, vzhodna polica · 17:16, tri minute pred zrušitvijo*

Deževnica je sikala skozi zgornjo razpoko. Pod njo se je šest izmen premikalo po poteh, ki so jih same izbrale. Ilya je držala dvostopenjski vzvod: prvi poteg bi poslal naložen rudniški vagon po triindevetdesetsekundnem razbremenilnem tiru in sprostil severno stopnišče; zadnji zapah bi vagon spustil v prazni usek in napel vlečno jeklenico čez razpoko. Lio je stala pri signalnem zvoncu. Oren je čakal pri mestnem pragu, še vedno zvezan in pripravljen prečkati, če ga Sef izpusti.

Pri spodnjem prelivu sta stala Ressa Daan, katere pekarna in klet sta zasedali prvo teraso, ter Toma Ely, ki so ga izbrala gospodinjstva vzhodne ulice. Držala sta odzivna zvonca. Nihče ni trdil, da govorita za vse mesto; nosila sta zabeležene odgovore ljudi ob poteh, ki bi sprejele enajstsekundni vodni sunek.

**Ilya**  
Prvi pogoj preizkusa: delavci lahko zavrnejo županovo obljubo zaposlitve, ne da bi izgubili pravico do plače.

**Sef**  
Če jih izpustim, kdo ohrani odvodno zavezo?
Dvignilo se je dvaintrideset rok. Nobena ni bila prisiljena.

**Delavci**  
Odvodno zavezo obnavljamo za to evakuacijo in za trideset dni. Potem so za obnovitev potrebni pregled, plačilo in zabeleženo glasovanje.

**Ilya**  
Drugi pogoj preizkusa: prizadeti ohranijo pravico, da popravo zavrnejo.

**Mina**  
Sprejmem trideset dni narazen.

**Cal**  
Sprejmem, da se morda ne bo vrnila.

Sef je odprl drobno dlan. Jantarna nit med otrokoma se je raztopila v tople iskre. Cal je omahnil, vendar ostal na nogah, ne da bi zgrabil Mino. Mina ga je držala za roko tri vdihe in ga izpustila. Obe izbiri sta obveljali.

V mestu se je Orenovo desno stopalo dvignilo. Prečkal je prag in stekel proti spodnjim odvodnim vratom z Liojinim rezervnim ključem. Njegova obljuba ni izginila; postala je zapis skrbi, škode in soglasja, ki ga je Lio sprejela.

**Sef**  
Kaj pa župan?

**Župan Vos**  
Ne osvobodi me dolga. Delavce osvobodi mojega ukaza.
Kamni obljub okoli kamnoloma so zažareli. Vrata rudniških vagonov so se odprla. Delavci, ki fizično niso mogli zapustiti dodeljenih mest, so se premaknili proti stopniščem.
Ob 17:18:07 se je vzhodna polica razklala.

**Ilya**  
Zdaj, Illuminara.

Ilya je potegnila prvo zarezo. Naložen vagon je začel triindevetdesetsekundni spust in sprostil severno stopnišče, ko so njegova kolesa napela jeklenico. Zaporedje so zgradile izmene; Illuminara jim je pokazala, kje ga bo razpoka sprejela.

Illuminara je stopila pod padajočo polico in dvignila obe roki. Dva milijona ton skrilavca sta obstala za dolžino sulice nad njo. Udarec ji je kolena zabil v kamen. Liojina ura se je začela s spustom vagona: triindevetdeset sekund do praznega useka.

Sef je videl šesto izmeno, še vedno ujeto za vrati z znamenjem pogodbe. Če bi jo izpustil, bi se stara zaveza za enajst sekund oslabila, preden bi obnovitev prostovoljcev dosegla kamne obljub. V teh sekundah bi spodnji preliv poplavil, vzhodna podporna cesta pa bi se lahko vdala.

**Sef**  
Če jih zadržim, gora spi, oni pa umrejo. Če jih osvobodim, plačajo drugi ljudje.

**Illuminara**  
Potem vprašaj ljudi, ki bi plačali.
Lio je odzvonila zaporedje vprašanja: enajst sekund, spodnji preliv, vzhodna cesta. Ressin zvonec je odgovoril enkrat: da, s pogojem. Tomin je odgovoril dvakrat: ne.

**Ressa**  
Preliv naj ostane odprt, tudi če poplavi mojo klet. Moje peči niso vredne ene izmene.

**Toma**  
Vzhodna ulica ni prazna. Šest gospodinjstev še premika nepokretne. Nobenih vrat, dokler Lio ne udari trikrat.

Ura je prešla enainštirideset sekund. Ilya je spremenila načrt. Izmena pri severnem stopnišču je pustila dva voza podpornega lesa in stekla prenesti zadnje prebivalce vzhodne ulice nad rdečo črto. Izgubljeni les je pomenil, da predelovalne dvorane ne bo mogoče rešiti.

**Sef**  
Sprejmeš klet in cesto?

**Ressa**  
Sprejmem svojo klet. Toma govori za cesto šele, ko so njegovi ljudje na varnem.
Ura je prešla oseminpetdeset sekund. Podpornik je počil ob Illuminarinem ramenu. Sefu ni ukazala in ni obljubila, da nihče ne bo prizadet.

Pri štiriinšestdesetih sekundah je Lio iz vzhodne ulice zaslišala tri odzivne zvonce in trikrat udarila po svojem. Toma je odgovoril enkrat. Pogoj je bil izpolnjen; njegov ne je postal da, ne da bi ga kdo preglasil.
Sef je pogledal Ilyo, ne župana.

**Sef**  
Če odprem vrata, bo tvoja izmena obnovila odvodno zavezo, preden doseže severno stopnišče?

**Ilya**  
Vprašaj jih.

Za rešetkami je šesta izmena odgovarjala človek za človekom. Enaindvajset jih je reklo da. Trije so rekli ne; delali so šestintrideset ur in niso hoteli sprejeti nobene nove obljube, preden se naspijo. Ilya je njihov odsek dodelila spočitim prostovoljcem, ki so soglašali v zapisnik.
Pri dvainsedemdesetih sekundah je Sef pogledal navaden železni pečat za pričo, ki ga je Lio pustila ob vzvodu. Vrata bi lahko odprl brez njega in ponudba ni bila plačilo. Vzel je samo ključ priče.

**Sef**  
Ena obravnava. Potem se odločim znova.
Pri petinsedemdesetih sekundah je Sef odprl vrata.

Gora Vey se je enajst sekund premikala. Oren je dosegel spodnja vrata in zasilni preliv zaklenil v odprtem položaju. Rjava voda je napolnila Ressino klet in vzhodno podporno cesto odnesla v zapuščeni sadovnjak. Šest gospodinjstev je bilo že nad njo. Lio je udarila novo zaporedje; spočiti prostovoljci so obnovili samo odvodno delo, ki so ga poimenovali. Svetli kamen zaveze je zdržal.

Pri oseminosemdesetih sekundah je naložen vagon dosegel prazni usek. Ilya je potegnila zadnji zapah. Vagon je padel, vlečna jeklenica se je napela in počena polica se je vzdolž črte, ki jo je označila Illuminara, obrnila proč od mesta.

**Ilya**  
Prosto!

Illuminara je pri dvaindevetdesetih sekundah izpustila kamen. Polica je padla v opuščeni kamnolom. Stara predelovalna dvorana, trije žerjavi in županov slavolok so izginili pod prahom. V Veyri se ni premaknila nobena hiša.

Mina se je za trenutek zasmejala, ne zato, ker bi bila izguba majhna, temveč ker ji je Cal pustil teči in je sam tekel ob nekom drugem. Tudi Illuminara se je zasmejala, brez sape in osupla. Zvok je bil njen, ne lekcija za kogar koli.
Sef je stal na njenem s prahom prekritem ramenu, ključ priče pa držal v voščeni dlani. Še vedno je bil majhen. Ni bil več videti kot ječar, a tudi nenevaren ne.

**Sef**  
Trije delavci so zavrnili. Toma je zavrnil, dokler njegovi ljudje niso bili na varnem. Zaveza je živela.

**Ilya**  
Dobro. Pred naslednjo obnovitvijo pridi pričat ceni.

scenes.title: Sodišče odprtih dlani
paragraphs: *Veyra, nekdanja županova hiša · zora naslednjega dne*

Sprednje sobe so postale začasna klinika, še preden se je prah polegel. Maro in otroka so skozi zimo obdržali tri sobe zgoraj; spomladi jim je sklad lahko ponudil ocenjen odkup le, če bi ga sprejeli. Vosova polovica hiše in vsi rudarski deleži v njegovi lasti so bili zapečateni v skladu za povračilo. Spal je na klopi pred pisarno za evidence in čakal na pričanje.
Za dolgo mizo so sedeli delavci, žalujoče družine, vajenci in pisarji, dva sedeža pa sta ostala prazna za ljudi, ki se še niso odločili, ali bodo sodelovali. Nad njimi ni visela nobena Sefova podoba.
Sef je sedel na enem od praznih sedežev in poleg dlani položil ključ priče. Stol je nadaljeval ponudbo, ki jo je sprejel za eno obravnavo, in ni bil nagrada za odprta vrata.

**Ilya**  
To sodišče hrani zapis, posluša ljudi, ki so se na obljubo zanesli, ter potrdi popravo ali oprostitev. Nove obljube ne more izsiliti.

**Sef**  
Kaj pa moja moč?

**Ilya**  
Prikrite posledice lahko narediš vidne. Telesa ne smeš zvezati, dokler prizadeti ni bil slišan in dokler tega ne zahteva neposredna varnost. Vsaka vez poteče, če je sodišče ne obnovi s soglasjem prizadetih.

**Sef**  
Bogu ponujate delo pisarja.

**Lio**  
Ponujamo ti priče, ki jih ni mogoče odpraviti kot vraževerje, kadar uradniki prelomijo besedo.
Sef je preučeval temne kamne, prinesene iz stare dvorane. Niso bili več skriti v stenah. Vsak je ležal poleg prošnje in imena človeka, pooblaščenega za odgovor.

**Sef**  
Služil bom trideset dni. Potem se odločim znova.

**Ilya**  
Tudi mi.
Oren je skozi vhodna vrata prinesel kotliček. Iz navade se je ustavil na pragu, nato ga je prečkal. Lio ni zaploskala. Prijela je težji ročaj in skupaj sta nočni izmeni odnesla čaj.

**Oren**  
Dvanajstih let ne morem popraviti z enim prečkanjem.

**Lio**  
Ne. Toda danes si prišel ven, ko sem te potrebovala zunaj.

Minin rečni voz je odpeljal opoldne. Cal je s Sefom prišel na postajo in ni prosil za obljubo. Mina mu je dala papirnati naslov, ki se utegne spremeniti. Cal ji je dal izrezljano piščalko in povedal, da je ni dolžna uporabiti.

Sef je gledal z resno pozornostjo bitja, ki se uči, da ima posledica lahko več kot eno obliko.

Pred odhodom je Illuminara postavila Liojin okrušeni zvonec na doseg njegove roke in odprla dlan pod robom njegovega stola. Sef je pogledal ponujeno roko, nato pa splezal dol po prečki stola.
